species.title: Species
species.description: Species used to select the built-in V-germline database.

min_clone_size.title: Minimum clone size
min_clone_size.description: Minimum number of sequences in a clone to be analysed.

sequence_column.title: Sequence column
sequence_column.description: Column containing the nucleotide sequence used by BrepPhylo (e.g. AIRR field 'sequence').

clone_id_column.title: Clone ID column
clone_id_column.description: Column that groups sequences into clones.

germline_id_column.title: Germline ID column
germline_id_column.description: Column with V gene annotations used to select the germline (e.g. 'V.GENE.and.allele').

label_column.title: Tip label column
label_column.description: Optional column used for tip labels. Must be unique within each clone.

class_palette.title: Class colour palette
class_palette.description: Mapping from class/isotype values to hex colours.

germline_colour.title: Germline colour
germline_colour.description: Colour used for germline tip (if plotted).

algorithm.title: Alignment algorithm
algorithm.description: Multiple sequence alignment algorithm used internally by BrepPhylo.

use_temp_dir.title: Use temporary directory
use_temp_dir.description: Let BrepPhylo create its own temporary directory for intermediate files.

gather_plots.title: Gather plots into single folder
gather_plots.description: If true, clone-level plots are copied into a dedicated 'plots' subdirectory.
